subject: Novamed evaluation — mutual action plan and acceptance ticklist
messages:
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
To: Timothy Park <tim.park@novamed.com>, Novamed Procurement <procurement@novamed.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 10 Apr 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: MAP & acceptance ticklist — Novamed evaluation (draft)

Timothy / procurement team,

Thanks again for the demo yesterday — great discussion. Attached is a short mutual action plan (MAP_Novamed_v1.xlsx) and an accompanying evaluation test cases doc (novamed-eval-test-cases.md). I wanted to capture a compact acceptance \"ticklist\" so everyone has the same definition of done for the 2-week trial. High-level items below; full detail is in the attachments.

Key milestones (timeline in MAP):
- Week 0 (kickoff): account setup, model selection, IP & data access, test dataset delivery from Novamed.
- Week 1: smoke tests, throughput/latency profiling, baseline accuracy on sample set.
- Week 2: regression scans, edge-case prompts, operational readiness review and sign-off.

Proposed acceptance ticklist (pass/fail thresholds):
- Latency: p95 generation <= 500ms for 75-token prompts under steady load (see test harness).
- Throughput: sustain 10 rps sustained without queue growth for 30 minutes per run.
- Accuracy/concordance: top-1 extraction F1 >= 92% on provided positive/neg sample.
- Hallucination: random sample rate < 1% (manual review sampling rules in test-cases doc).
- Security/compliance: SOC 2 summary & data retention answer provided; no PII persists in logs beyond agreed retention.
- Reliability: platform availability >= 99% during evaluation window.

Exit gates (fail-fast conditions):
- Reproducible critical hallucination per clinical template > 5% in validation set.
- Sustained p95 latency > 1.0s despite config adjustments.
- Customer data access or retention requirements cannot be satisfied within the Private deployment options agreed in the MAP.

Asks from Novamed for the kickoff: delivery of a representative test corpus (CSV), list of stakeholder reviewers (name + role + email), and procurement lead contact for SOW / billing. We can hold a 30-minute kickoff Tuesday morning PT — propose Tue 13 Apr 10:00am PT.

Next steps from our side: we’ll stand up a test deployment, share SOC2 summary, and seed the test harness (novamed-eval-test-cases.md).

Attachments: MAP_Novamed_v1.xlsx (spreadsheet), novamed-eval-test-cases.md (markdown).

Thanks,
Ben Carter
Senior Solutions Engineer — Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0132

--

Thanks for this. A few quick clarifications from our side before kickoff: 
1) Procurement wants the SOW + a one-page summary of pricing for the 2-week evaluation (so we can route internally). Can you attach the draft SOW and a short pricing note?
2) Security: our InfoSec team requires an existing SOC 2 report (or redwood-soc2-summary.pdf) and confirmation of log retention controls. Can you confirm retention window options?
3) On acceptance: the latency / throughput numbers look reasonable but our clinical reviewers will push on the hallucination test details. Can you share more on the manual review sampling plan?

Also, we need to add a late procurement step: a PO will be issued only after we receive a signed DocuSign SOW. If possible, include a standard cancellation clause for trial data deletion.

Happy to take the proposed Tue kickoff but can we move it to 11:00am PT? That gives our legal lead time to join for procurement items.

Best,

Subject: Novamed — updated MAP, SOW + acceptance clarifications

Timothy / procurement team,

Thanks for the quick turnaround — good call. Attached are: docusign-sow-novamed.pdf (Draft SOW), redwood-soc2-summary.pdf (SOC 2 executive summary), and an updated MAP (MAP_Novamed_v1.xlsx with a brief pricing tab). Key clarifications below, consolidated from the internal thread.

1) Pricing / SOW: One-page pricing (included in MAP tab) shows trial credit (no charge for the 2-week trial environment up to 50k tokens) and an estimated committed monthly price for the dedicated pool. DocuSign link for SOW: https://docusign.com/env/ABC123456789. Standard trial cancellation clause included (trial data deleted within 7 days of request; permanent deletion process in SOW).

2) Security / retention: redwood-soc2-summary.pdf covers controls; retention options we can commit to for the trial are: 30-day logs (default), 90-day logs (on request), and an option for 1-day ephemeral logs (for high-sensitivity datasets). Soojin attached a short note and the suggested SOW clause for trial-data deletion.

3) Acceptance criteria (finalized):
- Latency: p95 <= 500ms for 75-token generation under the defined steady-load benchmark (10 rps) in the test harness.
- Throughput: sustain 10 rps with <10% queueing for 30 minutes.
- Concordance / accuracy: top-1 extraction F1 >= 92% on Novamed verification set (seeded by customer).
- Hallucination: in a random sample of 400 responses across clinical templates, reproducible hallucination rate must be < 1%. Manual review protocol is summarized in novamed-eval-test-cases.md.
- Safety: no clinical recommendation language flagged by the review rubric more than once per 1,000 responses.
- Reliability: availability >= 99% during the trial window; we’ll provide token-level telemetry for verification.

4) Exit gates (if any of the following occur we recommend pausing the trial and a remediation sprint):
- Hallucination > 5% on any single clinical template in a verification run.
- p95 latency > 1.0s after two rounds of tuning (batching, model variant, instance sizing).
- Unresolvable data retention/legal requirements that block Private deployment options.

5) Next steps / timeline:
- Tue 14 Apr 11:00am PT — Kickoff (confirmed).
- Wed 15 Apr — Novamed delivers test corpus + reviewer list.
- Thu 16 Apr — Baseline smoke and initial latency profile.
- Mon 20 Apr — Full 2-week trial window begins (per MAP).

6) Links & admin: HubSpot deal: https://app.hubspot.com/deals/ND-2026-1147. DocuSign: https://docusign.com/env/ABC123456789.

Please confirm you received the SOW and SOC2 summary and that 11:00am PT works for kickoff. If procurement needs any wording tweaks in the SOW I can loop legal but want to keep the first pass lean.

Thanks — looking forward to the kickoff.

Best,
Ben Carter
